summary: According to the official warning label, taking lopinavir with certain other drugs can lead to significant interactions between medications [3]. A small computer model, rather than tests on people, gave lopinavir low scores for potential heart and liver concerns [M]. Additionally, a research trial studying the drug on its own showed unexpectedly high rates of treatment failure [6].
